## Body

#346 (PRD 008 pods) got BLOCK with 8 findings and merged after one fix range (7b2cc29b..028355eb). Lessons:
- Read-modify-write of a governance file: build it INSIDE the writer's serialized closure. Use directory.write_built and the pod mutate() helper, never open() then save(); concurrent verbs otherwise lose updates. Test: tokio::join! of two sets, then both values survive.
- Anything committed to governance (public) runs first_turn::secret_value on every --set, used or not, before ANY write. secret_line counted '/' as a key char, so absolute paths with capitals were false positives (fixed: paths are checked per segment).
- A one-shot subscriber that settles state needs a later re-entry path (pod confirm → recover()), or a printed fix can't work.
- A record field that set can change (subject, work-folder) needs ONE current source: update meta in the same write, and read through pod::work_folder.
- Record the template as resolved (repo-relative), not as typed (caller-relative).
- The text CLI renderer must handle both warning shapes (strings and {line}) and member `outcome`. Reviewers probe the text, not only the JSON.
- Mutants: run them all in one shared-build with copies in /tmp, then restore. Each must fail exactly its own test.
- The integration test binary for reshape_http is `directory_http` (filter pod_up).
